products.name: Promptfoo
products.note: Open-source prompt testing and red-teaming; declarative YAML test cases with deterministic assertions and LLM-graded checks; CI-first

reading.body:
Promptfoo is a testing platform that catches vulnerabilities in AI applications before deployment, using automated red-teaming and deterministic checks integrated into development workflows.

The core constraint on AI scaling is power and compute. Promptfoo sits upstream of that: it prevents wasted compute. A vulnerable application consumes resources without delivering reliable value. By catching prompt injection, jailbreaks, and logic failures in CI/CD pipelines rather than in production, Promptfoo reduces the computational waste of debugging broken systems after they ship. This matters because AI applications are capital-intensive. Testing that prevents a single major failure prevents wasted inference runs across thousands of users.

The product targets applied AI security rather than model capability evaluation. It covers business logic, retrieval systems, agents, and third-party integrations, which means it works at the application layer where most enterprises operate. This is the layer most exposed to adversarial input and configuration error. The data shows adoption across healthcare, telecommunications, retail, and enterprise software, which are industries with high costs of failure.

The data does not include revenue, funding, profitability, or whether the company has raised capital. It does not show how the platform scales with the number of tests, the model families it supports, or whether it has become a bottleneck in any customer's deployment pipeline.

profile_text.body:
Promptfoo is an AI security platform built to identify vulnerabilities in AI applications during development. The company describes itself as trusted by 156 of the Fortune 500 and more than 300,000 developers worldwide, with customers spanning healthcare, telecommunications, retail, and enterprise software.

The company's core product, also called Promptfoo, is an open-source prompt testing and red-teaming tool. It uses declarative YAML test cases with deterministic assertions and LLM-graded checks, and is designed to integrate into CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing. The platform covers more than 50 vulnerability types, including prompt injection and jailbreaks, and is aimed at testing business logic, retrieval-augmented generation systems, agents, and third-party integrations rather than model-level evaluation alone.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
